title: Systematic / Scoping Review
purpose: Transparent synthesis of a defined body of literature using a reproducible search, screening, appraisal and synthesis method.

sections.title: Title and Structured Abstract
sections.instruction: Identify review type and summarize objective, eligibility, sources, methods, results and conclusion.

sections.title: Rationale and Questions
sections.instruction: Explain why the review is needed and define question/framework (for example PICO, PICo or an appropriate domain-specific framework).

sections.title: Protocol and Registration
sections.instruction: State protocol location, registration, amendments, dates and reasons for deviations.

sections.title: Eligibility Criteria
sections.instruction: Define population, concept, context, study designs, language, date range, publication types and exclusions.

sections.title: Information Sources and Search Strategy
sections.instruction: Name every database, index, repository, website and date searched. Provide full reproducible search strings and limits.

sections.title: Selection Process
sections.instruction: Describe deduplication, reviewers, screening stages, conflict resolution and automation tools.

sections.title: Data Collection and Variables
sections.instruction: Define extraction form, variables, reviewers, verification, missing data and author contact.

sections.title: Risk of Bias / Quality Appraisal
sections.instruction: Select design-appropriate tools and explain judgments. Do not treat quality scores as universal truth.

sections.title: Synthesis Methods
sections.instruction: Explain grouping, transformations, qualitative synthesis, meta-analysis model, heterogeneity, sensitivity and publication bias where relevant.

sections.title: Results and Flow
sections.instruction: Provide screening counts, exclusions with reasons, study characteristics, appraisal and synthesis. Include appropriate PRISMA flow diagram.

sections.title: Discussion
sections.instruction: Interpret findings, limitations of evidence and review process, applicability and research priorities.

sections.title: Funding and Conflicts
sections.instruction: Declare review funding, competing interests and author contributions.

sections.title: Reporting Checklist
sections.instruction: Complete the current PRISMA 2020 checklist or relevant extension; preserve item-to-page/section mapping.
